primary_source.identity: Hubert Flenner and Mikhail Zaidenberg, Rational curves and rational singularities, math/0109221v1; published Math. Z. 244 (2003), 549-575, DOI 10.1007/s00209-003-0497-z
primary_source.locator: Section2.1, Theorem2.1 and its proof, PDF pp13-14; Lemma2.2, Proposition2.3 and the attributed Miyanishi Theorem2.4 on p13
primary_source.inspection: Exact statement, complete displayed proof of Theorem2.1 and dependency/affineness discussion read. This is adoption of the published authors theorem, not an independent reproof of every classical input.

application.scope: Every singularity of the full finite normalization Z of an actual complex polynomial plane Keller source is a finite quotient singularity; this suffices for the canonical L2 extension in LW0 and even-moment powers.
checked_hypotheses: Z is a normal affine algebraic surface, finite over the target plane
the canonical source lift j:A2->Z is an open immersion with dense image
for every boundary singular point p, every general source point lies on a polynomial source line whose image is closed in affine Z and avoids p
not_claimed: No cyclicity upgrade is needed or proved from FZ Theorem2.1
No independent reproduction of Miyanishi original paper
No differential IC socle or semisimple source-layer theorem
No automatic L4 integrability or trace perfection

underlying_classical_input.identity: Masayoshi Miyanishi, Singularities of normal affine surfaces containing cylinderlike open sets, J. Algebra 68 (1981), 268-275, DOI 10.1016/0021-8693(81)90264-7
underlying_classical_input.inspection: FZ Theorem2.4 exact restatement read. Original publisher full PDF unavailable (403; FULL API authentication required); metadata only accessible. Cyclic quotient conclusion of that restatement is not used as a separately independently audited result here.
